Design debt: T8 dead/processed cards rotate their text sideways and are hard to read
description: Wave 3 review (advisory, TASTE-style design finding): sideways dead cards rotate the whole card face, so name/stored text reads vertically and overlaps the DEAD MATTER band. Keep the sideways footprint but render the label and stored nutrients upright.
closeReason: Resolved by tablet redesign: dead and processed cards have landscape faces with upright labels and nutrients.

title: UX: tablet-first card-focused game screen with card closeup preview
description: Operator feedback on first deploy: too much chrome, focus must be on cards; cards must be visible without scrolling; tablet-first (gf uses a tablet), phone optional; tap/long-press a card opens a closeup preview. Research mobile TCG UX (Duel Links, Master Duel, Pokemon TCG Pocket) first. Also covers design debt envi-tcg-2f75 (sideways dead-card text). Operator kept it as one item despite step-up triggers (new UI files, spec target change).

title: Contain keyboard focus inside card closeups and menu dialogs
